usageNotes: Queries the current filesystem freeze state of a running VM via the QEMU Guest Agent; use this to confirm whether filesystems are frozen or thawed before or after backup operations. Requires the guest agent to be installed, running, and responsive inside the VM — the call will fail if the agent is not reachable. One of `VM.GuestAgent.Audit`, `VM.GuestAgent.FileSystemMgmt`, or `VM.GuestAgent.Unrestricted` privilege on `/vms/{vmid}` is sufficient.

examples.summary: Check filesystem freeze status on VM 200 running on node pve1

tips: The response wraps the guest agent reply in a `result` property; inspect `result` for the actual freeze state string (e.g. 'thawed' or 'frozen').
Call this after issuing fsfreeze-freeze or fsfreeze-thaw to verify the operation took effect before proceeding.
If the guest agent is not running, Proxmox returns a 500-level error — ensure `qemu-guest-agent` is active inside the guest OS.
This endpoint takes no body parameters; pass an empty JSON object `{}` or omit the body entirely.
